name: Get contact visited webpages
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the list of webpages a contact has visited, as shown in the contact's detail view under "Visited webpages". Use the list contacts action instead if you only need basic contact information without webpage history.
preconditions: The contact with the given ID must exist.

id.description: The unique identifier of the contact.

limit.description: Maximum number of visited webpage records to return.

offset.description: Number of records to skip before starting to collect the result set.

outputs.description: A list of visited webpage entries for the contact.

url.description: The URL of the visited page.

visitedAt.description: Timestamp when the page was visited.
